text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival. Many people gather from outside the academy on this day. True to its name, it is a celebration held for the fans.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Nice, a festival!
What do you say, Trainer?
Are you ready to have some fun, too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though we're on the hosting side for the Thanksgiving Festival,
one can't help but get swept up in the festive excitement.
choice_data_list: Have you ever joined a festival while traveling?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Of course. There were some I couldn't join depending on the venue,
but as long as I could,
I enjoyed myself to my heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A festival is built on the land, the people living there,
and all the memories connected between them.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: This festival surely won't be an exception either.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
“—In that case, we gotta liven things up!
Whether you're enjoying it or entertaining, that's just proper festival etiquette.”

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this, you actually came!
Long time no see~. How's that greeting go again...
Umm, Selam? Salaam? Was that it?

text_block_list.name: Foreign Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Selam!
Daijoubu! Konnichiwa!
I learned, a little bit of, words!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. Pretty impressive.
Huh? Did you get taller too?
Time really flies.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Evet! I grew very big!
Before, I was smaller than you~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
That's right, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Guest B
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Stay Gold!
So glad to see you! Have you been good!?

text_block_list.name: Foreign Guest C
text_block_list.text:
I FINALLY found you!
Long time no see, Stay Gold!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Haha, what do we have here?
Everywhere I look,
there's another familiar face!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The people coming up to talk to her one after another
seemed to be foreigners—
folks she had met during her travels.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Most people were speaking Japanese, but among them were some speaking languages that were completely unintelligible.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: All that with a translation device? Back when we first met, you were terrified of unfamiliar Umamusume, but you've gotten a lot more confident, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Umm, what's this...?
"You were so dignified that I became envious. I learned from your example"?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's great.
I think we'll see something far more interesting
than if you were shrinking back.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, are you Stay Gold's friends?
Hello-o!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It's a strange sight. Everyone speaks different languages. Yet right now, they're communicating using the same words and translation devices.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I see. Everyone saw online videos and knew I was here... I get it now.
So that's why you went out of your way to come here.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Then why don't we keep the journey going a bit longer?
Think of it as part of the festival's attractions.
choice_data_list: A performance? But if we're reserving a spot, we'll need permission...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It's fine, it's not needed.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Everyone, gather round!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Everyone I met on my journey!
And to all of you I'm meeting here for the first time,
how was your trip to Tracen Academy!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Every encounter is a precious experience.
Whether it's meeting for the first time or reuniting,
there's always a touch of emotion to be found."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't you like to experience that excitement once more, right here!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing upon the empty stage while preparations for the curtain rise are still underway,
Stay Gold shouts at the top of her lungs.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
What's going on? What's about to start?
There's nothing written in the pamphlet, though...
Could it be a surprise event!?

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's Stay Gold!
I thought I might not get to see you...
I'm so glad I came~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold's voice drew everyone's gaze.
They all seemed thrilled by her presence
and her words in their own ways.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Find me!
It's a game of hide-and-seek using the entire academy!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The time limit is one hour.
If you find it... let's see.
Maybe something—

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan
text_block_list.text: An autograph! I'd love to get your autograph, Stay Gold-san!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hm? That's really okay?
Alright, let's do it!
Everyone, count down ten seconds! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Now!
Let our little journey begin!

text_block_list.name: Excited People
text_block_list.text: "Ten! Nine! Eight! Seven!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While I was still reeling in surprise, things kept moving forward, and before I knew it, a game of hide-and-seek with an absurd number of participants had begun.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What...!? Stego-senpai is missing!?
I shall begin the search immediately, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Whereabouts...? 
No! Hiding... P-Please
wait a second!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Speaking of which, earlier...
Whoops, nothing in life is free, right?
...How 'bout we make a little wager?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wha...
By 'challenge', do you mean at a festival stall or something!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Her whereabouts?
...How insolent.
By what right do you question me?

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...! Um, I thought
you might know about it...
N-No, never mind! Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Many people run around asking questions, but no one can pinpoint Stay Gold's whereabouts.

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Participant
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? If I find Stay Gold-san,
I get a signature board from Dream Journey-san, Golshi-san... and everyone else!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: The prize is a bit unusual, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, it's incredibly lively.
To think a simple game of hide-and-seek
could get everyone this excited—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh. As expected, you were the first to find me.
How did you know I was here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the saying goes "hide a tree in the forest," even in hide-and-seek,
it was hard to picture her sneaking around and concealing herself.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. Well, you're right.
From here, I can hear them calling for me in the distance,
and still feel the excitement of the competition."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It looks like everywhere is buzzing with excitement, which is awesome.
choice_data_list: Apparently the fans interact with each other too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. People from nearby and faraway lands all gathered here at once,
sharing in this same little journey right now.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Perhaps Tracen Academy is a place that naturally attracts encounters like that.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I'm sure it will become a fond memory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the bustling festival,
Stay Gold's eyes narrowed with delight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A place that brings encounters together. That might be true. But at the same time, I can't help but think...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're staring at my face and grinning...
What is it?
choice_data_list: The destination of their first journey was you.
The destination of their first journey was you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At the very least, for those who traveled from distant lands,
I believe their initial destination wasn't Tracen Academy, but Stay Gold."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They might never have even met.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…………
...I'm the destination of the journey, huh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well now... I certainly didn't anticipate that.
It's quite a strange feeling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As someone constantly on the move, it probably never crossed her mind that she herself could become someone else's destination. Wearing a somewhat puzzled expression, she offered a small smile.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Oops. It's almost been an hour.
The only one who found me was Trainer, huh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, you know.
'We couldn't find it, the end'...
That's just no fun."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
How about a game of tag from here on?
You and I are the ones running away.
If either of us gets caught, game over.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Are you confident you can lead all the way?
choice_data_list: Running away on foot isn't your only escape route, you know!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh, nice! That's what I'm talking about!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright, guess I'll announce
the next game over the broadcast.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Let us have everyone chase after the next destination—the goal!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As someone constantly on the move, it probably never crossed her mind that she herself could become someone else's destination.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Found you!
I never expected to find you in a place like this...!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Found 'em! Everyone, I found 'em!!
Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Um, what's this say...?
"We found it because everyone worked together"?
Yeah, yeah, totally! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as Stay Gold said, this will surely become an unforgettable, wonderful memory.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oops, you found me.
Haha. Aw man, at this rate, everyone's a winner.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Still, how'd you manage to spot me in this crowd?
Not to sell myself short, but I don't exactly stand out, do I?

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Actually, I saw you running off,
Trainer, so...
when I chased after you, well...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft. Ahahaha!
Looks like you ended up becoming the checkpoint flag for the destination.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright, in that case, it's an autograph frenzy!
You're helping me out, too.
You ready for this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers erupted, and people who had been complete strangers
high-fived each other. Stay Gold watched it all,
quietly smiling to herself.
